about: Recorded audio library for the demo input layer (task M.14, PRODUCT_VISION.md §6 and §9). Each item points at an evaluation scenario (evaluation/scenarios/<scenarioId>.json): its conversation is the script the team reads aloud, and its expected result is the label fixed before any run. Recordings are the team's own voices, saved as audio/<scenarioId>.wav; they are git-ignored and never committed. Audio is never generated.
